title: Digital systems
summary: Discover how digital devices work and how different types of data are encoded, stored and organised.

title: Programming & Algorithms
summary: Use programming tools and computational thinking to create purposeful programs. Design and apply step-by-step algorithms to solve problems, find and debug errors, then test and improve your solutions.

title: Data and Information
summary: Use digital tools and data to solve problems. Collect information, organise it in spreadsheets and graphs, and identify patterns.

title: Digital citizenship
summary: Make safe, thoughtful digital choices by considering security, reliability, accuracy, usability and bias, and evaluating misinformation, AI suitability and ethical impacts.

title: Systems and control
summary: Explore mechanical, electrical, electronic and digital systems. Use circuit symbols, build simple circuits and investigate subsystems, feedback, input-process-output relationships and combined systems.

title: Infrastructure & Networking
summary: Computer hardware, software, operating systems, input-process-output, networks and connectivity.

title: Binary & Data
summary: Binary numbers, encoding, decoding and how computers represent information.

title: Binary Piano
summary: Build or use the binary place-value model; identify 0/1 and place values.

title: Encoding Binary
summary: Convert small decimal values and a short coded word using the binary piano.

title: Decoding Binary
summary: Read binary values and check results with a partner.

title: Representing Images
summary: Investigate a simple pixel/grid image representation; encode or recreate an image.

title: Text Compression
summary: Explore repeated information and simple ways to shorten a representation; compare what is preserved.

title: Parity Game
summary: Use a card-flip/parity demonstration to detect a change in encoded information.

title: ASCII
summary: Use a character table to encode/decode short text; discuss its limitations.

title: Unicode and te reo Māori
summary: Compare how characters including macrons can be represented; explain why wider character support matters.

title: Design a coded message
summary: Choose an audience, create a small encoded message or image, test it with a partner and refine.

title: Consolidation
summary: Demonstrate or explain how a device uses stored data to produce an output.
